object: EXACT CLASSIFICATION OF MIXED-LITERAL HUANG LOCAL EQUALITY SEMANTICS AFTER THE E4 C10 FACTORIZATION

source_scope.underlying_graph: Huang G_{C7,I} with arbitrary positive/negative 3-CNF literal occurrences; no Janus-added graph edges
source_scope.P7: Use only Huang's source theorem that the C7 construction is P7-free.
source_scope.hardness: Do not use Huang NP-hardness as a substitute for the relation proof; if an NP-completeness consequence is stated, derive the exact Boolean language first and bind it to Schaefer.

primary_identity.target: Prove q_{j,t}=e_i for a positive occurrence and q_{j,t}=1-e_i for a negative occurrence.

local_language_test: Reconstruct the 14 E4 upward equality relations M on q in {0,1}^3.
Apply all 2^3 coordinate polarity flips q=e xor sigma.
Deduplicate the resulting signed relation language.
Classify the full language under the frozen six Schaefer predicates: 0-valid, 1-valid, Horn, dual-Horn, bijunctive, affine.
Also classify the signed transforms of the root relation q1 OR q2 OR q3.
barrier_firewall: No common Schaefer basis is not a proof that no polynomial algorithm exists unless P!=NP is assumed.
A polynomial exact carrier for unrestricted connected instances of a Schaefer-hard signed language would imply P=NP.
This gate must not claim P!=NP.
This gate must not authorize recursive general R1/R2 or C5C.
next_if_barrier: Search for an additional source restriction on the signed Huang incidence/polarity system that excludes unrestricted Schaefer-hard composition.
Or explicitly treat the remaining step as a P-vs-NP-scale carrier problem rather than routine glue.
